notes.title: Major Update II/II (Added playhouse, mini-games, private booths & more!)
notes.content:
[b]🎉 Major Update - Part 2 🎉[/b]

Hey everyone, we truly appreciate your support and feedback—it’s because of you that we’ve been able to continuously improve the game. With this update, we’re introducing a ton of new features, balance changes, and quality-of-life improvements, but we’ll need your help once again to fine-tune everything and ensure the game remains fair and fun for everyone. 😊

[h2]🏰 The Playhouse & Mini-Games![/h2]
[b]Playhouse & Lycan Shop Cycle:[/b]
[list]
[*] Lycan Shop is closed on the first day, and then alternates every day.
[*] Playhouse is open when the Lycan Shop is closed.
[*] Option added to enable/disable the shop/playhouse for custom games.[/list]
[b]New Playhouse Additions:[/b][list]
[*] The Night Altar: Can only be activated at night by a human – burns & cages a Werewolf for the night.
[*] Private Booths: Two booths for private conversations & LC exchange (limit: 5 LC per day).[/list]
[h3]🕹️ Playhouse Minigames (All games can be played once per half-day):[/h3][list]
[*] 💪 Test of Strength (1 LC on loss, 6 LC on win)
[*] 🔥 Light Up the Candles (1 LC on loss, up to 6 LC based on candles lit)
[*] 🪓 Perfect Log Split (1 LC on loss, 3 LC on win)
[*] 🤹 The Jester’s Balance (1 LC on loss, 3 LC on win)
[*] 🎩 The Cup Shuffle (1 LC on loss, up to 8 LC if you gamble)
[*] 🐴 Land the Horseshoe (1 LC on loss, 5 LC on win)
[*] 🧠 The Mystic Sequence (1 LC on loss, 5 LC on win)
[*] 🎰 Spin for Fortune (6 different outcomes depending on luck)
[/list]
[h2]🛒 Lycan Shop Updates[/h2]
[b]Item Replacements:[/b][list]
[*] 🧥 "Invisibility Cloak" → "Sleep Invisibility" (Makes you invisible only while asleep for the entire night).
[*] 🏃‍♂️ "Night Pitchfork" → "Night Stamina" (Reduces stamina consumption for one night).[/list]
[b]New Purchasable Service: “Ship Repair”[/b]
[list]
[*] Once purchased, everyone is notified that the ship will be ready by night.
[*] At nightfall, everyone is awake, all Werewolf roles transform, and villagers gain pitchforks.
[*] Players must either fight the Werewolves or push the ship to escape![/list]
[h2]⚖️ Balance Changes[/h2]
[b]Daily LC Earnings:[/b]
[list]
[*] Everyone now gets 1 LC per day
[*] Villager-Role get 10 LC per day[/list]
[b]Voting System Rework:[/b]
[list]
[*] Now, instead of forcing a UI pop-up, players get a small prompt to press “K” to open the voting panel.
[*] You can recast your vote before the timer ends.
[*] When voting begins, all eligible voters are now teleported to the voting tower.[/list]
[b]Perk Buffs:[/b]
[list]
[*] Easy Dream: Now requires only 10 points instead of 20 to win.
[*] Speed Burst: Grants 5 seconds of high-speed movement + infinite stamina during the burst.[/list]
-New Sleeping Options: 12 benches added outside where players can sleep.
-Coin System Changes: Coins and coinbags no longer spawn around the map.
-Private LC Exchange Booth: A new booth on the second floor of the tavern allows for private conversations & LC exchange.
-Dream Mechanics Rework: Half-Asleep Mode is now the default – players can dream, but they can’t hear or see anything while dreaming.


[h2]🆕 New Features & Improvements[/h2]
-Voting Transparency: A message now shows who started a vote (can be toggled off in game setup).
-Morning Bed Names: See who slept where when morning arrives (can be toggled off in game setup).
-Cemetery gate adjusted: No longer kills players unless a sacrifice is needed for the Blood Moon.
-Shopkeeper adjusted: Instead of killing you, the shopkeeper now ragdolls you after a slap.
-Sleep Countdown: When falling asleep, a countdown starts, after which you cannot wake up during the day.
-Performance Options: Added render distance settings and enable/disable shadows for lower-end PCs.
-New Bed Models: Beds have been redesigned with a fresh look.
-Werewolf Wake-up Protection: Players get 0.5 seconds of invulnerability after being woken up by a Werewolf.
-Morning Transition: Footsteps and growls stop playing when morning arrives, with a smoother transition.
-No More Body Looting: Instead of looting the body, the dead now drop a coinbag containing all their LC.
-Spectator Mode Rework: Now called Ghost Mode – roam in first-person after death, voice chat with other ghosts in proximity, and hear the living.
-Bigger Werewolf Model: The Werewolf has been slightly enlarged.
-12-Player Support: Games can now have up to 12 players!

This update brings us one step closer to a full release! With your feedback, we’ll continue refining and polishing the game until it reaches its full potential. Thank you for being part of this journey!

All the best,
Sam & Abbie

notes.title: Major Update I/II (Added NPC, items, coins, levels & achievements)
notes.content:
[b]🎉 Major Update - Part 1 🎉[/b]
Hey everyone, we’ve got some exciting new changes and fixes coming to Werewolf Party! Here’s what you can expect in this first part of the update:

[h3]🏪 Lycan Shop:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Lycan Shop is now open, and an NPC at the Tavern sells items for Lycan Coins scattered around the map. Items sold are:

[list]
[*] Pitchfork: Use once in the following night.
[*] Invisibility Cloak: Activates after purchase, lasts during the day.
[*] Door Lock: Lock any door for one night.
[*] Flintlock Pistol: Single-shot pistol usable during the day.
[*] Werewolf Potion: Only for Wolf Cub/Traitor roles, turns you into a full Werewolf.[/list][/list]
[h3]💰 Lycan Coins & Rewards:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Every day, you can find 30 LC (1x Coin Bag, 2x Coin Pieces) randomly spawned around the map.
[*] Villager-role earn 10 LC per night survived, and other roles earn 5 LC.
[*] Players drop their Lycan Coins when they die.[/list]
[h3]🏰 Map & Environment Updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added functional windows to the Tavern.
[*] Added water and a ship for future content.
[*] Placed miscellaneous objects around the map for future content.[/list]
[h3]🏅 EXP & Leveling System:[/h3][list]
[*] Players can now earn EXP and level up to unlock exclusive pins:
[list]

[*] Novice: Bronze Pin
[*] Trickster: Silver Pin
[*] Mastermind: Gold Pin[/list][/list]
[h3]⚙️ Gameplay Updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Emote: Press 7 to write on a sign and share messages with other players.
[*] Stamina Logic Update: Improved stamina management for smoother gameplay.
[*] Priest Role Probability: Now set to 70% by default.
[*] Bloodmoon Changes: Now requires the sacrifice of two players to prevent the Bloodmoon.
[*] Improved Movement: Updated player movement and crouching logic for better jumping and climbing.
[*] Voting Logic: Once the voting begins, all sleeping players will wake up.
[/list]
[h3]🏆 Achievements Added:[/h3]
[list]
[*] 45+ Achievements have been added, and more to come.
[/list]
[h3]🧢 Cosmetic Additions:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Skins and Hats: 5 more options added.
[/list]
[h3]🛠️ Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the black screen issue when spectating.
[*] Fixed the grunting sounds during sleep.
[*] Fixed the Pookie dream background.
[*] Stopped the camera from clipping through objects in third-person view.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy these new features and improvements. Your feedback is always welcome, so feel free to share your thoughts with us. 

We will be available to patch any bugs that pop up on the spot! Make a post on the steam community or on our discord server, and we will fix it as quickly as possible.

-Sam & Abbie

notes.title: New update! 8 Languages + Customizable Game Setup 🐺
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are Sam and Abbie, the duo behind Absam Studios.

When we started working on Werewolf Party, our goal was to create a fun game reminiscent of the classic Mafia/Werewolf card game that friends can enjoy together. We had a blast coming up with new roles and scenarios, adding our personal touch to make the game enjoyable and accessible to everyone.

Since Werewolf Party’s release on June 7th, the response has been incredible. We genuinely did not anticipate this much love and support for our game and were blown away by the positive reactions after our launch giveaways on our Discord server.

Now we have an amazing community that keeps growing every day. We're very grateful for how things turned out and for everyone’s constructive feedback.

Our community’s feedback has played an important role in shaping our vision for the game and what we want it to look like after this early access version.

[h3]Multiple Languages Added:[/h3]

Two weeks post-launch, we’ve responded to our international community’s request for game translation, and now the game is available in 8 languages: English, French, Spanish, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Turkish.

This allows everyone to fully engage with the game's roles and guides, experience the game to the fullest, and most importantly, have fun together.

[h3]Customizable Game Setup:[/h3]

We have added new game settings that allow players a more personalized gameplay experience.

[b]Role Probability, Voting, and Day/Night Cycles:[/b]
- Control the probability of roles assigned in the game
- Adjust day and night cycles time
- Set vote time
- Set safe time for roles that awake at night

[b]List Roles:[/b]
- Choose whether to display available roles at the beginning of each game session

[b]List Teams:[/b]
- Opt to see team compositions at the start of each game session (e.g., Team Villager has 10 members, Team Werewolf has 2 members)

[b]Death Alert:[/b]
- Choose to receive or not receive alerts when a player dies (e.g., [X player has died])

[b]Awake Alert:[/b]
- Enable or disable alerts for when roles wake up at night (e.g., [Guard is awake], [Seer is awake])

Thank you all so much. If you haven't joined our community in discord, you can reach us here:
https://discord.com/invite/werewolfparty
